description: Implementation uses Manrope, off-white page background, and production shell tokens instead of Plus Jakarta Sans, white background, and teal design tokens.
Design uses 928px content columns positioned by 256px side padding; implementation uses a centered 768px content column.
Design feature image is full viewport/container width at 1440x520 with square corners; implementation is constrained to 1200px, 16:9, and rounded.
Design body begins with structured Introduction/Conclusion headings, paragraphs, inline image caption, and blockquote; implementation renders real sanitized CMS content plus an excerpt callout.
Implementation adds a related-articles section that is not present in the HTML design reference.
Header and footer exist, but production shell labels and typography differ from the static design reference.
